seo_title: Fanfare: Framer Agency Template Design | The Brandle
summary: A loud, motion-led Framer template for creative studios that would rather make an entrance.
description: Fanfare, a motion-led Framer template for creative studios and agencies. Designed and built by The Brandle, a Dubai design and development studio.

brief.label: Framer template, agencies
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Most studio sites whisper. Fanfare walks in with a brass band.

It is a Framer template for creative studios, agencies and freelancers who sell identity, web and launch work. The logo is drawn on screen like a designer's file, fills with colour and wipes away, then the headline rises letter by letter.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: What's inside
paras: Twelve written pages, eight case studies, four services and eight journal posts, all on Framer's CMS. Swap in your logo, colours and projects, and launch.
The preloader is yours in one step: replace one logo layer and it redraws itself around your mark, in your accent colour. No video to render, no code to touch.
It is on the Framer Marketplace. The applause is not included, but it is strongly implied.
